versions.changelog:
- Updated skill description to focus on all-in-one, production-ready long-form video creation from simple text prompts.
- Clarified key features such as full filmmaking workflow support, AI lip-sync, subtitles, BGM, and transitions.
- Target use cases expanded: AIGC feature films, short plays, TVC, social media, education, and product demos.
- Removed legacy descriptions in the introduction, improved English-language summary for global clarity.
- No changes to APIs, backend scripts, logic, or workflow steps. No functional changes in workflow or requirements.

seko-video-creation 1.0.0

- Initial release of a one-stop AI-driven video creation skill for long/short videos, AIGC short plays, and film/video project planning (script writing, art direction, character/scene design, storyboarding).
- Supports fully managed workflow: project creation, proposal (策划案) generation, async task/query management, video creation, and asset download.
- Enforces clear, stepwise execution according to PLAN.md milestones; all interactions and outputs must be in Chinese.
- Integrates with Seko API using SEKO_API_KEY; provides task status and explicit error handling.
- Strict path and environment variable management; project and output files organized under {PROJECT_DIR}.
- Fully documents and tracks proposals and generated videos via markdown and task queue records, with user confirmations required at every milestone.
